title: Audit dependency and release supply chain
description: Audit dependencies, CI actions, downloaded tunnel binaries, artifact integrity, and release permissions before publication.
acceptanceCriteria: Dependency audit results are recorded with severity and disposition
CI/release actions are pinned to immutable commit SHAs where practical and permissions are least-privilege
Tunnel binary versions, sources, checksums/licenses, and architecture are pinned or explicitly documented as dynamic/verified
Release artifacts have checksum and provenance gates without claiming attestation proves safety
Known vulnerabilities/blockers have an owner and release decision

steps.details: Run the repository-supported `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` and record output; do not auto-upgrade dependencies without compatibility tests.
Inspect `.github/workflows/*.yml` for unpinned actions, broad permissions, secret exposure, and release ordering.
Trace install.sh/bootstrap.sh binary URLs, versions, mirrors, checksums, licenses, and architecture mapping; record gaps without downloading or executing untrusted binaries.
Create `.agent/evidence/supply-chain.md` with findings, severity, disposition, and unresolved blockers; keep pass false until reviewed.

technicalNotes: GitHub CLI authentication is available but tokens must never be printed or copied into evidence.
